behavior: An outside press closes the popup before the listeners of the pressed element run, as in Base UI. Such a listener reads the open state after the close. Thus an outside element whose listener toggles the open state opens the popup again. In Base UI, a listener that reads the open state of the last render closes the popup. To toggle a popup from an outside element, use a detached trigger, or call `details.cancel()` in `onOpenChange` for the press on that element.
